test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a component of the Microsoft Office 2019 package?
solution:
Microsoft Office 2019 package includes:

• Microsoft OneNote

• Microsoft Outlook

• Microsoft Excel

**Keynote is not its component **rather it is a default Apple application used for creating presentations for the iOS.

Hence,** 'option 3'** is the correct answer.
